items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: do all the Thad Jones, Ernie Wilkins charts man, Neal Hefti charts, do whatever you want.

ctx.x: See? See that’s it. Another thing that Harry James did, and I learned this from him too, he signed your paycheck. And sometimes, most times, he would hand you your paycheck. And I noticed this too when we were doing this a lot, when a guy says, “Thank you for the job” or just grabs it. Harry James would hire an individual that had a great attitude and maybe not the player that this guy is, but this guy has a lousy attitude, but this guy’s got a positive attitude. He’d keep the job. That’s what he wanted. And…

enforcement — a national law enforcement association or something. And they said, “And now, Harry James” and he walks out and people applaud. Harry comes up and he says — and he always started with the theme, like we do, “Ciribiribin” and then “Don’t Be That Way” because that’s what Benny opened Carnegie Hall with. We still do that. That’s tradition. And it fits. And he walked on the stage and he says, “Jazz Connoisseur.” Well that’s one of his favorite Ernie Wilkins charts, right? I hadn’t played it yet. I’d…
